passages.text: A room booking may last at most four hours.
Bookings can be made up to 30 days in advance.
A booking can be cancelled without a charge until two hours before its start.
Cancelling less than two hours before the start incurs a ten-credit charge.
Check in within 15 minutes of the start time. Otherwise the room is released.
Guests need a host present throughout the booking.
Food is permitted in rooms A and B. Food is prohibited in room C.
The projector must be requested when the booking is created.
A recurring booking can include up to eight weekly occurrences.

Changing a recurring booking affects only the selected occurrence unless all future
occurrences are selected.
Room B accommodates six people. The occupancy limit must not be exceeded.
The booking receipt is sent to the organizer, not to every attendee.

passages.text:
Ordinary support messages are deleted after 30 days. This rule has an exception
described on the following page; consult that exception before answering questions
about legal holds.

Exception to the ordinary support-message retention rule: messages under an
active legal hold are kept until the hold is released, even after 30 days.
Financial invoices are retained for seven years from their issue date.

An export request includes active records and archived records, but excludes
records already deleted.
Only compliance administrators can apply a legal hold.

Releasing a legal hold requires two different compliance administrators to approve
the release.

Deleting an account disables sign-in immediately. Record retention continues under
the applicable retention rules.
An audit event records the actor, UTC time, and record identifier for every deletion.
Attachments follow the retention period of the message to which they belong.
A retention preview lists records scheduled for deletion during the next 24 hours.

Changing a retention policy affects future deletion decisions and does not restore
records already deleted.
The retention service pauses deletion when its policy database is unavailable.

Autosave does not run for documents opened in read-only mode.
The recovery panel offers the most recent autosaved version after an unexpected exit.
Closing a document with unsaved changes prompts the user to save, discard, or cancel closing.

The editor preserves UTF-8 encoding when saving a UTF-8 text file.
Tabs are displayed as four spaces by default; this setting changes display width without rewriting the file.

Uploads paused by the user do not resume automatically after relaunch.
The retry button restarts the failed upload from the beginning.
Upload filenames are preserved in the destination folder.

An interrupted network connection leaves the upload in the Failed state.
A completed upload shows the destination path in its details.
The upload history retains the latest 100 jobs.
Removing a job from history does not delete its uploaded file.
The upload queue runs two jobs concurrently.

passages.text: The green status light means the printer is ready.
The blue status light means the printer is receiving a job.
The orange status light means the paper tray is empty.
Use A4 or Letter plain paper in the main tray.
The main tray holds at most 150 sheets.
Envelopes must be fed one at a time through the rear slot.
To cancel the active print job, hold Cancel for two seconds.
Cleaning the rollers requires disconnecting the power cable first.
The printer enters sleep mode after ten minutes without a job.
Press any control-panel button to wake the printer from sleep.
The printer rejects jobs protected by an unsupported encryption format.
